snippet.title: Blast Processed - Official Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description: Blast Processed is a first-person platformer built around an infamous movement quirk of early FPS games: Rocket Jumping. Now available for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2758150/Blast_Processed/
